arguments.text: Settle now. Long smooth strokes, find your race rhythm.

10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Calibration: pod CP 173 W, reserve 13 kJ (may be 10-25 pct off). Plan: settle to pod power near CP (about 170-180 W) after the hard start, even effort by power not pace (current changes ground pace by leg). Keep pod reserve above about 30 pct until the last 1500 m, then spend it: push at 1500 m to go, finish sprint at about 600 m. Watch for drag incidents (push_local drop with same power), instrument drift (pod vs boat power disagreement), radio course changes.

arguments.description: Share of pod shaft power that shows up as boat-model power; drops with extra drag (weed on rudder) or pod reading high, rises if pod reads low.

arguments.text: Min 1: hard start, pod 260 W vs CP 173, reserve 60 pct. Cued ease at 1.0 min. Early boat_to_pod_ratio about 0.60-0.63 (boat power / pod power). Leg 1 heading north had push about +0.2 m/s (current helps outbound?).

text: Cued ease to settle the hard start (pod 260 W vs CP 173, reserve 60 pct); set plan, watches on reserve, low power and boat/pod power ratio, wake-ups at 1600 m and 650 m to go.

arguments.text: Min 4: settled at pod 176 W (CP 173), rate 66, pod reserve 27 pct after the start. Sustainable pod power about 174 W: on target, hold this. Reserve watch moved to 12 pct.

arguments.text: Ease a touch. Smooth and steady into the current.

Min 7 leg 2 (south, current against, push -0.17): pod crept to 182 W, reserve 19 pct, empties in 850 m. Cued a small ease. Target pod about 170-175 W. Reserve has no room: keep at or just under CP until 1500 m to go.

text: Cued a small ease: pod 182 W above CP 173 with reserve at 19 pct and draining into the current.

Speed at same rate dropped 4 pct: drag (rudder weed?) or fatigue

arguments.text: Min 10: POD DRIFTING LOW. boat_to_pod_ratio was steady 0.68 to race s 490, then rose to 0.90 by s 600, while GPS speed (2.98), rate 66 and boat power (121-123) stayed flat. So pod shaft power, w_bal_pod_frac, push_local_mps are now wrong (read low / reserve falsely refilling). Do NOT cue push on pod numbers. Use boat power_w (CP 120) and w_bal_frac. Removed pod watches; added boat reserve, boat power high, fade watches.

10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. POD UNRELIABLE since min 8.5 (reads about 25 pct low; see notes): judge effort by boat power_w (CP 120 W, reserve 5.6 kJ), w_bal_frac, GPS speed at rate 66, fade_pct. Target boat power about 118-124 W, even effort (slightly more into current, slightly less with it). Boat reserve is low (about 17 pct), so no surges until 1500 m to go; then push, finish sprint at about 600 m. Watch for drag incidents (fade_pct drop at same rate), radio course changes.

text: no cue: pod is drifting low while speed, rate and boat power are unchanged; switched watches and plan to boat-model power, effort is on target.

Speed through water well below CP pace: blow-up or drag?

arguments.text: Min 12 leg 3 (north, with current): boat reserve model reads 1 pct (CP 120 W), but paddler said 5/10, all good, plenty; no fade (fade_pct +3.9); leg GPS speeds similar to leg 1. Boat CP 120 likely a bit low and fitted current lags (power_w inflated on with-current legs). Pod reserve before drift was about 18 pct at min 8. Cued a small ease on the with-current leg (cheapest place to save). Removed boat reserve watch (would refire); added blowup watch on speed_water < 2.95.

text: Cued a small ease on the with-current leg: boat model says reserve empty (likely pessimistic, paddler says 5/10), easing here is the cheapest insurance.

arguments.text: Min 15: boat model reserve 0 pct for 3 min yet paddler held boat 125-132 W with no forced slowdown and no fade; said 5/10 at min 12. Evidence the test CP (boat 120, pod 173, same test) is low. Pod keeps drifting (now about 128 W, useless). Testing: cued a modest push for leg 4 into the current (where extra power pays most). If no fade/blowup and paddler OK by min 18-19, raise boat CP with set_critical_power (to about 128) and hold the higher power.

text: Cued a modest push for the into-current leg to test whether CP is higher than the test said (boat reserve model empty but no slowdown); check in 200 s.

arguments.reason: Paddler held boat power 121-132 W for 7 min with the boat reserve model at 0 pct and no forced slowdown, no fade, and reports 5-6/10 with plenty left at min 12 and 18: test CP 120 W is too low.

arguments.text: You are strong today. Press a bit harder into this current.

10 km, 10 legs of 1000 m. POD UNRELIABLE since min 8.5 (drifting low; ignore shaft power, pod reserve, push_local). Judge effort by boat power_w, speed_water, fade_pct, and asking the paddler. Min 18: raised boat CP 120 -> 128 W (evidence: held 121-132 W at modelled zero reserve with no slowdown, paddler 5-6/10 plenty); reserve now about 70 pct. Target boat power about 130 W: about 132 into the current (south legs), about 127 with it (north legs). Raise CP again only with more evidence (still no fade, paddler under 7/10). Push from 1500 m to go, finish sprint at about 600 m. Watch for drag incidents (fade drop at same rate), radio course changes, blow-up (speed_water < 2.95).

Min 18: paddler 6/10 plenty. Set boat CP 128 W (1 of 3 uses), reserve recomputed to 70 pct. Push cue at min 15 gave only about +3 W. Cued push again into the current (leg 4, south). Next: check fade and speed_water; if steady at about 130 W with no fade by min 25, consider more.

text: Raised boat CP to 128 W on evidence (no slowdown at modelled empty reserve, paddler 6/10) and cued a push into the current toward about 132 W.
